db:insert.doc:name: Insert run (STARTED)
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO compliance_report_runs (run_id, report_type, entity_code, report_date, period_start, period_end, is_revision, revision_of_run_id, triggered_by, run_status, notification_status, started_at, correlation_id) VALUES (:runId, :reportType, :entityCode, :reportDate, :periodStart, :periodEnd, :isRevision, :revisionOfRunId, :triggeredBy, 'STARTED', 'PENDING', NOW(), :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ runId: payload.runId, reportType: payload.reportType, entityCode: payload.entityCode, reportDate: payload.reportDate as String, periodStart: payload.periodStart, periodEnd: payload.periodEnd, isRevision: payload.isRevision default false, revisionOfRunId: payload.revisionOfRunId, triggeredBy: payload.triggeredBy, correlationId: payload.correlationId default correlationId }]

db:select.doc:name: Select run
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, report_type, entity_code, DATE_FORMAT(report_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS report_date, DATE_FORMAT(period_start, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS period_start, DATE_FORMAT(period_end, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, revision_of_run_id, record_count, total_amount, customer_count, completeness_ok, is_nil_report, output_file_path, archive_file_path, file_checksum, detail_checksum, prev_chain_hash, chain_hash, delivery_method, volume_deviation_pct, notification_status, triggered_by, run_status, error_code, error_message, ai_summary, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS started_at, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS completed_at, correlation_id FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE run_id = :runId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import mapRun from dwl::runMapper output application/json --- mapRun(payload[0])

db:select.doc:name: Select runs
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, report_type, entity_code, DATE_FORMAT(report_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS report_date, DATE_FORMAT(period_start, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS period_start, DATE_FORMAT(period_end, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, revision_of_run_id, record_count, total_amount, customer_count, completeness_ok, is_nil_report, output_file_path, archive_file_path, file_checksum, detail_checksum, prev_chain_hash, chain_hash, delivery_method, volume_deviation_pct, notification_status, triggered_by, run_status, error_code, error_message, ai_summary, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS started_at, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS completed_at, correlation_id FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND (:status IS NULL OR run_status = :status) AND (:reportDate IS NULL OR report_date = :reportDate) ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT :maxRows
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[{ reportType: attributes.queryParams.reportType default p('report.defaultType'), entityCode: attributes.queryParams.entityCode default p('report.defaultEntity'), status: attributes.queryParams.status, reportDate: attributes.queryParams.reportDate, maxRows: (attributes.queryParams.limit default 30) as Number }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import mapRun from dwl::runMapper output application/json --- payload map mapRun($)

raise-error.description: runStatus SUCCESS can only be set through POST /reports/finalize
No updatable fields in request body
raise-error.doc:name: Empty update

db:select.doc:name: Max issued sequence
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_number), 0) + 1 AS next_sequence, COUNT(sequence_number) AS issued_count FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND period_start = :periodStart

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { nextSequence: payload[0].next_sequence as Number, issuedCount: payload[0].issued_count as Number }

db:select.doc:name: Issued runs
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, DATE_FORMAT(report_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS report_date, sequence_number, file_checksum, prev_chain_hash, chain_hash, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS completed_at FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE report_type = :reportType AND entity_code = :entityCode AND run_status = 'SUCCESS' AND chain_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY completed_at, run_id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map { runId: $.run_id, reportDate: $.report_date, sequenceNumber: if ($.sequence_number == null) null else $.sequence_number as Number, fileChecksum: $.file_checksum, prevChainHash: $.prev_chain_hash, chainHash: $.chain_hash, completedAt: $.completed_at }

db:select.doc:name: Chain head
db:select.db:sql: SELECT r.run_id, r.chain_hash FROM compliance_report_runs r WHERE r.report_type = :reportType AND r.entity_code = :entityCode AND r.run_status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.chain_hash IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM compliance_report_runs n WHERE n.report_type = r.report_type AND n.entity_code = r.entity_code AND n.run_status = 'SUCCESS' AND n.prev_chain_hash = r.chain_hash) ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC, r.run_id DESC LIMIT 1
